name: Love Rewound
source:
You go to college. Meet a guy. Fall in love. Maybe break some hearts in the process. But have you ever wanted to get into the head of the love interests of the story? See how they fell just as hard for you as you did for them?

Love Rewound is a romance visual novel with two paths--one from the perspective of the guy that wins your heart, and one from the guy who gets heartbroken in the process. Look back on your romance with them from their eyes--and give them your own feedback on it every now and then. This is your story, your love, rewound. 

[From [url=https://charitydoesgames.itch.io/love-rewound]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你去上大学。认识一个男人。爱上。也许在这个过程中伤了一些人的心。但你有没有想过深入了解故事中的爱情故事呢？看看他们是如何像你为他们一样深深地迷恋你的吗？

《Love Rewound》是一部浪漫视觉小说，有两条路——一条从赢得你心的人的角度出发，另一条从在这个过程中心碎的人的角度出发。从他们的角度回顾你们与他们的浪漫史，并时不时地向他们提供你自己的反馈。这是你的故事，你的爱，倒带。

[来自[url=https://charitydoesgames.itch.io/love-rewound]itch.io[/url]]
